card.capacity_status_quote: We continue to make solid progress to increase our capacity and improve product yields, and we expect to see ongoing incremental progress across our fab operations during the remainder of fiscal 2026.
card.demand_direction_quote: Demand for our products is strong across our 3 end markets, and our backlog continues to build.
card.guidance_direction_quote: The Data Center segment stands out with a revised full-year growth rate exceeding 60% as product diversification and hyperscaler demand accelerate.
card.constraint_owner_quote: We estimate fiscal year 2026 CapEx to be in the range of $55 million to $65 million as we expand capacity to meet demand requirements across our end markets
